FLAT FEE LEGAL SERVICES AGREEMENT

Brightwater & Osei LLP
77 Commerce Street, Suite 1400
Nashville, Tennessee 37201

October 12, 2026

Ravi Chandrasekaran-Boyd
Chandrasekaran Robotics, LLC
415 Wedgewood Avenue
Nashville, Tennessee 37203

Re: Formation and Seed Financing — Flat Fee Engagement

Dear Ravi,

Thank you for asking Brightwater & Osei LLP to represent Chandrasekaran Robotics, LLC. This letter states the terms of our engagement. Please read it, sign the enclosed copy, and return it with the initial payment.

1. THE CLIENT

Our client is Chandrasekaran Robotics, LLC only. We do not represent you individually, and we do not represent any other member, officer, employee, or investor of the company. You should consider retaining your own counsel for your personal interests, including the terms on which you hold your equity.

2. SCOPE OF THE ENGAGEMENT

We will provide the following services for the flat fee stated in Section 3:

(a) converting the company from a Tennessee limited liability company to a Delaware corporation, including the plan of conversion, the certificate of conversion, the certificate of incorporation, and the bylaws;
(b) preparing and issuing founder stock, including restricted stock purchase agreements, 83(b) election forms, and the capitalization table;
(c) preparing an equity incentive plan and form option documents;
(d) preparing and negotiating a seed financing of up to $3,000,000 on a Y Combinator post-money SAFE or an NVCA-form preferred stock purchase agreement, whichever the company elects; and
(e) preparing form employment offer letters, a form contractor agreement, and a confidential information and invention assignment agreement.

3. THE FLAT FEE

3.1 Amount. The flat fee for the services described in Section 2 is $34,500.

3.2 Payment Schedule. The fee is payable $12,000 on signing, $12,000 on the filing of the certificate of incorporation, and $10,500 on the closing of the seed financing or on March 31, 2027, whichever comes first.

3.3 What the Flat Fee Covers. The flat fee covers our professional time for the services in Section 2 regardless of how many hours the work takes. It is not an advance against hourly fees.

3.4 Earned on Receipt. The flat fee is not earned on receipt. Each payment is deposited into our trust account and is withdrawn as the corresponding services are performed, as Tennessee Rule of Professional Conduct 1.15 requires. If the engagement ends before the services are complete, we will refund the portion of the fee that we have not earned, measured by the services performed and the time expended, within thirty days after the engagement ends.

3.5 Expenses. The flat fee does not include expenses. Filing fees, franchise tax deposits, the Delaware registered agent fee, courier charges, and third-party search fees are billed to you at cost as they are incurred, and are payable within thirty days of the invoice. We will not incur a single expense over $500 without your approval.

4. WHAT IS NOT COVERED

The flat fee does not cover: a financing above $3,000,000 or on terms materially different from the forms in Section 2(d); intellectual property prosecution; tax opinions; securities filings other than the Form D and the Tennessee notice filing; litigation or any dispute; employment matters beyond the forms in Section 2(e); or diligence responses to an investor beyond one round of comments. If you ask us to handle a matter outside Section 2, we will agree a separate flat fee or an hourly rate with you in writing before we begin.

5. HOW WE WILL WORK TOGETHER

Chidera Osei will be the responsible partner. Associates and paralegals will work on the matter as appropriate. Because this is a flat fee, the staffing mix does not change what you pay. We will keep you informed of significant developments, will respond to your questions promptly, and will consult you before taking any step that materially affects your rights or obligations. You will provide the information and documents we need, will keep us informed of changes, and will make the decisions that are yours to make, including whether to accept any financing terms.

6. CONFLICTS

We have run a conflicts check and have identified no conflict that prevents this engagement. We represent many companies and investors, and we may in the future be asked to represent a party adverse to you in an unrelated matter. You agree that we may do so, provided the matter is not substantially related to our work for you and we do not use your confidential information, as Tennessee Rule of Professional Conduct 1.7 permits with informed consent confirmed in writing. This consent does not extend to any matter substantially related to this engagement.

7. CONFIDENTIALITY

We will keep confidential all information relating to the representation, as Tennessee Rule of Professional Conduct 1.6 requires, and will disclose it only with your informed consent, as impliedly authorized to carry out the representation, or as that rule otherwise permits.

8. FILE RETENTION

At the end of the engagement we will return your original documents on request and will retain the file for seven years, after which we may destroy it without further notice. You may request a copy of the file at any time; we may charge the cost of copying.

9. ENDING THE ENGAGEMENT

You may end this engagement at any time, with or without cause, by written notice. We may withdraw as Tennessee Rule of Professional Conduct 1.16 permits, including for non-payment, after giving you reasonable notice and taking steps to protect your interests. If we withdraw or you discharge us, you will pay the earned portion of the flat fee and all expenses incurred through that date, and we will cooperate in transferring the matter.

10. NO GUARANTEE

We have made no promise about the outcome of the seed financing or of any other matter, and none should be inferred from anything we have said.

11. DISPUTES

If a dispute arises about our fees, you may submit it to the Nashville Bar Association fee dispute resolution program. Any other dispute arising out of this engagement is governed by Tennessee law and must be brought in the state or federal courts located in Davidson County, Tennessee. Nothing in this letter limits your right to file a complaint with the Tennessee Board of Professional Responsibility.

12. THE WHOLE AGREEMENT

This letter is the entire agreement about this engagement. It may be changed only in a writing signed by both of us. If any part of it is unenforceable, the rest remains in effect.

We are glad to be working with you.

Very truly yours,

BRIGHTWATER & OSEI LLP

/s/ Chidera Osei
Chidera Osei
Partner

AGREED AND ACCEPTED

CHANDRASEKARAN ROBOTICS, LLC
